title: Apex Temperature Control Overshoot
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apex:reading
| search temp_overshoot_c=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(temp_overshoot_c) as avg_temp_overshoot_c max(temp_overshoot_c) as max_temp_overshoot_c by _time tank_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Apex temperature overshoot over time and breaks it out by tank.
value: Overshoot trends show when heaters, chillers, or control tuning are becoming too aggressive.
implementation: Send Apex temperature overshoot events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Apex temperature overshoot by tank.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how Apex temperature overshoot changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
